RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the March 5, 2003/Phalguna 14, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Coal; Defence; Home Affairs; Mines; Non-Conventional Energy
Sources; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Power;
Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20
Visa-rackets
*201. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the increasing visa-rackets in the country;
(b) if so, the places where such visa-
rackets are taking place; and
(c) the action taken to curb them?
Installation of computers in police
stations in Delhi
*202. SHRIMATI N. P. DURGA:
SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
 SEKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Delhi Police propose to
install computers at certain police stations
to ensure early availability of data which
can help in expeditious investigation of
cases;
(b) if so, the number of police stations
where computers have been or are
proposed to be installed; and
62
(c) by when computers will be in place
at all the police stations?
Inclusion of regional language in the
Eighth Schedule of Constitution
*203. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) what is the criteria for inclusion of
a regional language in the Eighth Schedule
of the Constitution of India;
(b) Whether there was demand for
inclusion of ‘Tulu’ language in the Eighth
Schedule, considering its rich cultural and
historical value and for the fact that it is
spoken by a vast number of people in
Karnataka, Kerala, Maharashtra, Gujarat,
Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and even to
some extent in Delhi; and
(c) if so, the details in this regard and
reaction of Government thereto?
Child abuse
*204. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI  BHAGATRAM MAN-
HAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the problem

63
WIN2\SESSION\7742RS.pm5 63
of child abuse, particularly sexual abuse
is rampant in India;
(b) if so, what are the details of the
crimes of child abuse reported during the
last one year in various States/UTs;
(c) whether it is also a fact that first
report of the implementation of the
Convention on the Rights of Child (CRC)
observed that India lacked separate
legislation to deal with such cases; and
(d) if so, what steps Government
propose to take after going through the
report of CRC?
Surveillance stations of Indian Coast
Guard
*205. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up more stations for surveillance by Indian
Coast Guard along the coasts;
(b) if so, the number of such stations
and the names of the States where these
stations are to be set up; and
(c) the funds allocated for this project
and the likely date of its implementation?
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
*206. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the system of sanctioning new road
projects under the Pradhan Mantri Gram
Sadak Yojana to States;
(b) how many such projects have been
sanctioned for Maharashtra (Marathwada
and Vidarbha separately) during the current
financial year alongwith details of their
budgetary support, targets fixed and
whether monitoring of such targets is
done; and
(c) if so, whether these targets are
being achieved and if not, what are the
reasons therefor?
Roads constructed under PMGSY in
Himachal Pradesh
*207. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the funds allotted so far to Himachal
Pradesh under the Pradhan Mantri Gram
Sadak Yojana;
(b) details of utilisation of funds by
the State Government, district-wise; and
(c) details of roads constructed,
district-wise and panchayat-wise, under
the scheme?
Criminals escaping abroad after
committing crime

SINGH ‘LALAN’:
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large
number of people after committing crimes
in India during the last three years have
escaped abroad;
(b) if so, the total number thereof and
the countries they are hiding in;
(c) whether Government have contacted
the Governments of those countries for
their extradition and for trying them in the
court; and

accelerate the process of digitisation and
computerisation of land records in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and

Lignite deposits found in Barmer,
Rajasthan
1387. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
COAL be pleased to state:
(a) details of lignite deposits found in
Barmer District. of Rajasthan;
(b) at what depth those lignite deposits
are situated;
(c) the details of proposals received for
mining of those lignite deposits;
(d) whether the Government of Rajasthan
have sent to the Central Government the
proposals of three companies for setting up
of thermal power plants for the extraction
of lignite from those mines and if so, the
details thereof; and
(e) what action Government are
contemplating to clear those proposals ?
Irregularities in coal linkage
†1388. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether some cases regarding
irregularities in coal linkage have come to
light;
(b) if so, the total number of such
companies whose permission has been
cancelled; and
(c) whether any case has also been
registered against any of these companies ?
Awarding contracts without tenders
†1389. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government's coal
companies have a system of awarding
contracts without tenders;
(b) if so, the extent to which officers of
different levels have been authorised to do so;
(c) if so, whether complaints of bungling
in such cases have ever been reported; and
(d) the outcomes thereof?
Coal production
1390. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) the target set for production of coal
during the Ninth Five Year Plan;
(b) how far this target has been achieved;
(c) the target set for the Tenth Five Year
Plan; and
(d) whether Government propose to
enhance production of coal during the Tenth
Plan?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Coal shortage in Singareni Coal Mine
1391. DR. AKHILESH DAS: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that acting on a
SOS from Singareni Colliery Management
following the recent indefinite strike by coal
miners, the Union Government constituted
a crisis resolution Group, if so, the terms of
the Group;
(b) the main demands of the workers;
and how the issues were resolved; and
(c) the steps taken to meet the coal
shortage with the projects and the people
fed by the colliery?
Closure of loss making mines
1392. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have been
actively considering to closing down of
some of the loss making mines in the
country;
(b) if so, the facts and details thereof;
(c) whether the exact causes of losses of
such coal mines have been assessed;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government have taken any
steps to revive such loss making coal mines;
and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
P.F. office in Godavarikham in Andhra
Pradesh
1393. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to open
a Provident Fund office in Godavarikham
in Karimnagar District of Andhra Pradesh,
for the benefit of Singareni Coal Company
Ltd.; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Waiving off of arrears of retired Army,
Navy and Air Force Officers
1394. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to waive off recovery of 'arrears'
worth Rs. 1.85 crores ordered by Controller
of Defence Accounts, from about 1500
retired officers belonging to Army, Air Force
and Navy after Court's intervention, as
reported in Pioneer of 19th January, 2003;
and
(b) if so, whether responsibility is being
fixed for this financial loss coupled with
infructuous expenditure incurred on court
cases?
Movement of troops to peace-time
locations
1395. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether all border troops have
moved back to their peace-time locations
after more than a year; and
(b) if so, reasons with details thereof?
Purchase of AJT
1396. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to purchase British Hawk
aircraft for induction in IAF;
(b) if so, the details thereof;

study of Czech aircraft L-159B; and
(d) if so, the difference between the
British Hawk aircraft and the Czech aircraft
L-159B with regard to our requirements?
